svg.title: A person decides an agent step, which runs the normal command of the module
svg.desc: A permitted person opens the waiting step, sees the before and after values, and approves. The runtime calls the command of the owning module with the token of that person. The command checks rights, duties and business rules and saves in one transaction. If refused, the step stays waiting and shows the reason.
